name: Leftover Turkey Green Bean Cheddar Casserole
why: Oven-baked casserole, 416 cal / 12.5g carbs (9g net) per serving on the source's numbers - low end of the cal band but comfortably inside it, well under the carb ceiling. Structurally low-carb (turkey + green beans + cheese + mayo, no rice/pasta/potato). Whole-muscle turkey maps to turkey-breast; green beans, shredded cheddar, garlic, mayonnaise, cranberry-sauce, walnuts all map to the board. Goat cheese has NO board home - flagged for the pricer lane (a deliberate unmapped case to prove the queue). Protein is 23.6g, a touch under the 25g identity ideal, so lower confidence than the stuffed peppers; source uses sugar-free cranberry sauce for the stated carbs. Scales to 14 as a bake.
